outcome: Probability and confidence diagnostics disclose their different populations and preserve original decisions.

artifacts.purpose: Categorical probability and signal result types
Losses, deterministic argmax, bins and ECE

interfaces: Probability metrics use all selected rows including abstentions; confidence bins use raw answered rows only.
Episode evidence separates original/working vector, argmax, max/chosen probability, disagreement and confidence.
Ten bins use min(floor(10*h),9); tie argmax uses vocabulary order.
acceptance_criteria: [0.7,0.2,0.1] true A gives -ln(0.7), Brier 0.14; [1,0,0] true B gives infinite loss and Brier 2.
Argmax disagreement excludes raw abstentions and exposes raw answered count; chosen probability/disagreement are null on abstention.
Bins include/exclude exact IDs, means, counts, bounds and correct counts; only maximum-probability bins produce top-label ECE.

verification.expected: Finite and infinite oracles agree with full multiclass Brier scaling.
As-recorded probability and confidence populations preserve abstentions, exact included/excluded IDs, bins, and counts; threshold-rejected evidence is owned by T021.
Adjacent binary64 values at boundaries, including 1, go to correct bins.

verification_responsibility: A different agent from the implementation author reruns evidence and reviews every acceptance criterion; integrator accepts only the saved response.
